<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/university-enrollment">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_UniversityEnrollment" name="University enrollment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Enrollment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Student" name="Student">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Enrollment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideMissingItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmEnrollment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Confirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Canceled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOrientation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ObtainStudentID</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCourses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddDropSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddDropCourses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddDropJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BeginAttendingClasses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddDropPeriod</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewGrades</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Grievance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitAppeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AwaitAppealDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GrievanceJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StudentStatus</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Graduated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Withdrawn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Admissions" name="Admissions office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Documents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMissingItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ApplicationOutcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAcceptanceLetter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRejectionLetter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetUpStudentAccounts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_International</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InternationalJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AdmissionsCommittee" name="Admissions committee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ApplicationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Finance department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessFeesOrWaivers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_InternationalOffice" name="International student office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssistVisaProcessing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AcademicAdvisor" name="Academic advisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MeetAdvisor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ResolveScheduleConflicts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AppealsCommittee" name="Appeals committee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MeetAppealsCommittee</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Enrollment" name="Enrollment application process begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit application online"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewApplication" name="Review application and supporting documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Documents" name="Are all documents received?" default="Flow_DocumentsMissing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMissingItems" name="Notify applicant of missing items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideMissingItems" name="Provide missing items"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ApplicationSplit" name="Begin concurrent processing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateApplication" name="Evaluate application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessFeesOrWaivers" name="Process applicable fees or waivers"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ApplicationJoin" name="Concurrent processing complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApplicationOutcome" name="Is the application accepted?" default="Flow_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendAcceptanceLetter" name="Send acceptance letter"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendRejectionLetter" name="Send rejection letter"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Application rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" name="Confirm enrollment by the deadline"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Confirmation" name="Was enrollment confirmed by the deadline?" default="Flow_NotConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Canceled" name="Application canceled"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveOrientation" name="Receive orientation materials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetUpStudentAccounts" name="Set up email, online portal, and library accounts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_International" name="Is the student international?" default="Flow_NotInternational"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssistVisaProcessing" name="Assist with visa processing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalJoin" name="Continue enrollment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainStudentID" name="Obtain student ID card"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MeetAdvisor" name="Meet with academic advisor"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCourses" name="Select courses"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResolveScheduleConflicts" name="Resolve schedule conflicts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BeginAttendingClasses" name="Begin attending classes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddDropPeriod" name="Proceed through the semester add/drop period"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddDropSplit" name="Add or drop any courses?" default="Flow_SkipAddDrop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddDropCourses" name="Add or drop courses"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddDropJoin" name="Continue semester"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostGrades" name="Post grades"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewGrades" name="Review grades online"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Grievance" name="Does the student have a grievance?" default="Flow_NoGrievance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitAppeal" name="Submit appeal form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" name="Meet with appeals committee"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" name="Await appeal decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GrievanceJoin" name="Continue after grievance decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentStatus" name="Graduated, withdrawn, or continuing?" default="Flow_ContinueStudies"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Graduated" name="Student graduates"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Withdrawn" name="Student withdraws"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Submit" sourceRef="StartEvent_Enrollment" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Review" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Task_ReviewApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Documents" sourceRef="Task_ReviewApplication" targetRef="Gateway_Documents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsComplete" name="All documents received" sourceRef="Gateway_Documents" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allDocumentsReceived</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsMissing" name="Documents missing" sourceRef="Gateway_Documents" targetRef="Task_NotifyMissingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Provide" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMissingItems" targetRef="Task_ProvideMissingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Provide_Review" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMissingItems" targetRef="Task_ReviewApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicationSplit_Evaluate" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicationSplit_Finance" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationSplit" targetRef="Task_ProcessFeesOrWaivers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evaluate_Join" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Finance_Join" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFeesOrWaivers" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Outcome" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accepted" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptanceLetter">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">applicationAccepted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Not accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendRejectionLetter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejection_End" sourceRef="Task_SendRejectionLetter" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Acceptance_Confirm" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptanceLetter" targetRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" targetRef="Gateway_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmed" name="Confirmed by deadline" sourceRef="Gateway_Confirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrientation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">confirmedByDeadline</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotConfirmed" name="Not confirmed by deadline" sourceRef="Gateway_Confirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_Canceled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Orientation_Accounts" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrientation" targetRef="Task_SetUpStudentAccounts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accounts_International" sourceRef="Task_SetUpStudentAccounts" targetRef="Gateway_International"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_International_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_International" targetRef="Task_AssistVisaProcessing">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">isInternational</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInternational" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_International" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_Join" sourceRef="Task_AssistVisaProcessing" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InternationalJoin_ID" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalJoin" targetRef="Task_ObtainStudentID"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ID_Advisor" sourceRef="Task_ObtainStudentID" targetRef="Task_MeetAdvisor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Advisor_Select" sourceRef="Task_MeetAdvisor" targetRef="Task_SelectCourses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Resolve" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourses" targetRef="Task_ResolveScheduleConflicts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Resolve_Classes" sourceRef="Task_ResolveScheduleConflicts" targetRef="Task_BeginAttendingClasses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Classes_AddDropPeriod" sourceRef="Task_BeginAttendingClasses" targetRef="Task_AddDropPeriod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddDropPeriod_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_AddDropPeriod" targetRef="Gateway_AddDropSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DoAddDrop" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDropSplit" targetRef="Task_AddDropCourses">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">coursesToAddOrDrop</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipAddDrop" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDropSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AddDropJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddDrop_Join" sourceRef="Task_AddDropCourses" targetRef="Gateway_AddDropJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddDrop_PostGrades" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDropJoin" targetRef="Task_PostGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostGrades_Review" sourceRef="Task_PostGrades" targetRef="Task_ReviewGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Grievance" sourceRef="Task_ReviewGrades" targetRef="Gateway_Grievance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasGrievance" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Grievance" targetRef="Task_SubmitAppeal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hasGrievance</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGrievance" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Grievance" targetRef="Gateway_GrievanceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitAppeal_Meet" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAppeal" targetRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Meet_AwaitDecision" sourceRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" targetRef="Task_AwaitAppealDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AwaitDecision_Join" sourceRef="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" targetRef="Gateway_GrievanceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GrievanceJoin_Status" sourceRef="Gateway_GrievanceJoin" targetRef="Gateway_StudentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Graduated" name="Graduated" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentStatus" targetRef="EndEvent_Graduated">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">studentGraduates</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdrawn" name="Withdrawn" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentStatus" targetRef="EndEvent_Withdrawn">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">studentWithdraws</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContinueStudies" name="Continue next semester" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentStatus" targetRef="Task_BeginAttendingClasses"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/university-enrollment">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_UniversityEnrollment" name="University enrollment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Enrollment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Student" name="Applicant / student">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Application</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideMissingItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmEnrollment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Confirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Canceled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOrientation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_International</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InternationalMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ObtainStudentID</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StudyPlanSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCourses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ResolveScheduleConflicts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StudyPlanJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BeginAttendingClasses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddDrop</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddDropCourses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddDropMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewGrades</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Grievance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitAppealForm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AwaitAppealDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GrievanceMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StudentStatus</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Graduated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Withdrawn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Admissions" name="Admissions office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Documents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMissingItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ApplicationOutcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAcceptanceLetter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRejectionLetter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AdmissionsCommittee" name="Admissions committee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Finance department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessFeesOrWaivers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetUpStudentAccounts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_InternationalOffice" name="International student office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssistVisaProcessing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AcademicAdvisor" name="Academic advisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MeetAcademicAdvisor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AppealsCommittee" name="Appeals committee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MeetAppealsCommittee</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Application" name="Application process begins"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit application online"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewApplication" name="Review application and supporting documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Documents" name="Are all documents received?" default="Flow_DocumentsMissing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMissingItems" name="Notify applicant to provide missing items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideMissingItems" name="Provide missing items"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ApplicationSplit" name="Start concurrent application processing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateApplication" name="Evaluate application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessFeesOrWaivers" name="Process application fees or waivers"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ApplicationJoin" name="Concurrent application processing complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApplicationOutcome" name="Is the application accepted?" default="Flow_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendAcceptanceLetter" name="Send acceptance letter"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendRejectionLetter" name="Send rejection letter"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Application rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" name="Confirm enrollment by the specified deadline"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Confirmation" name="Was enrollment confirmed by the deadline?" default="Flow_NotConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Canceled" name="Application canceled"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AfterConfirmationSplit" name="Begin post-confirmation activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveOrientation" name="Receive orientation materials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetUpStudentAccounts" name="Set up email, online portal, and library accounts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_International" name="Is the student international?" default="Flow_NotInternational"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssistVisaProcessing" name="Assist with visa processing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalMerge" name="Continue international-student processing"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AfterConfirmationJoin" name="Post-confirmation activities complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainStudentID" name="Obtain student ID card"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StudyPlanSplit" name="Complete study-plan activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MeetAcademicAdvisor" name="Meet with academic advisor"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCourses" name="Select courses"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResolveScheduleConflicts" name="Resolve schedule conflicts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StudyPlanJoin" name="Study-plan activities complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BeginAttendingClasses" name="Begin attending classes"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddDrop" name="Add or drop courses during the add/drop period?" default="Flow_SkipAddDrop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddDropCourses" name="Add or drop courses within the add/drop period"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddDropMerge" name="Continue semester"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostGrades" name="Post grades"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewGrades" name="Review grades online"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Grievance" name="Does the student have a grievance?" default="Flow_NoGrievance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitAppealForm" name="Submit appeal form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" name="Meet with appeals committee"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" name="Await appeal decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GrievanceMerge" name="Continue after grievance decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentStatus" name="Has the student graduated or withdrawn?" default="Flow_ContinueStudies"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Graduated" name="Student graduates"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Withdrawn" name="Student withdraws"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Submit" sourceRef="Start_Application" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Review" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Task_ReviewApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Documents" sourceRef="Task_ReviewApplication" targetRef="Gateway_Documents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsComplete" name="All documents received" sourceRef="Gateway_Documents" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allDocumentsReceived</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsMissing" name="Documents missing" sourceRef="Gateway_Documents" targetRef="Task_NotifyMissingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Provide" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMissingItems" targetRef="Task_ProvideMissingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Provide_Review" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMissingItems" targetRef="Task_ReviewApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicationSplit_Evaluate" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicationSplit_Finance" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationSplit" targetRef="Task_ProcessFeesOrWaivers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evaluate_ApplicationJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Finance_ApplicationJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFeesOrWaivers" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicationJoin_Outcome" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accepted" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptanceLetter">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">applicationAccepted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Not accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendRejectionLetter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejection_End" sourceRef="Task_SendRejectionLetter" targetRef="End_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Acceptance_Confirm" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptanceLetter" targetRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment"/>
